property_summary: For any admissible (amount, calldata) with a call target that rejects Ether, Command (whose low-level call's failure is ignored) must not revert and the sent Ether must remain on the contract; the mutant always pays the Owner EOA instead, so the Ether leaves and c's balance is 0 for any positive amount.
change_summary: Replace adr with Owner as the call target so commands and value are always sent to the Owner.
